ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has released the exam date for the post of Scientist / Engineer. This recruitment was released for 175 posts. Online applying process for ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 August 2026 to 16 September 2026. The CBT examination is going to conducted on 19 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their IISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Exam Date 2026 from the link given below

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 August 2026
  • Last Date : 16 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 19 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH, ESM : Rs. 750/-
  • All Category : Rs. 750/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
